items.title: Data shows why Australians are stuck and not switching jobs or starting businesses
items.description: People are less mobile, less dynamic and more risk-averse than we used to be, a series of economic indicators shows.

items.title: Trump's deal-making leaves Iran in the driver's seat and Israel more vulnerable
items.description: Israel goes from looking like the new regional hegemon to looking like it is under greater threat now than it has in years, while Iran now has room to rebuild its proxies.

items.title: First Australian activist detained from Gaza flotilla returns home
items.description: Gemma O'Toole is the first of 11 Australian activists detained by Israel off the Gaza-bound Global Sumud Flotilla to arrive back in Australia.

items.title: The migration maths behind the housing crisis is not what politicians claim
items.description: Arthur Calwell argued migration was essential to national survival. Today, the Coalition says it should depend on how many homes get built, but the economics are far from straightforward.

items.title: The link between terrorism and DV could be key to preventing homicide
items.description: A world-first research project is aiming to prevent family and intimate partner homicides with similar strategies to those being used to tackle terrorism and lone-actor attacks.

items.title: Top spy boss first witness as antisemitism royal commission resumes
items.description: The head of Australia's spy agency will be the first witness when the royal commission on antisemitism resumes this week.

items.title: Why global conflict is reshaping Australian politics
items.description: US President Donald Trump was yesterday touting an end to the war in Iran, but declaring mission accomplished in Washington will not spare Australian consumers, and politicians, from the economic fallout of the conflict.

items.title: Unlocking Australia's 'distinctive strength' in the early hours
items.description: Australia has a "distinctive strength" when it comes to early trading, but more knowledge is needed for businesses to fully capitalise on it.

items.title: Live: Piastri and Norris suffer as McLaren take tyre risk in Canada
items.description: Oscar Piastri's hopes of fighting for victory in Montreal appear to have been dashed before the start of the Canadian Grand Prix. Follow live.

items.title: Head of Victoria's new childcare watchdog vows to protect kids
items.description: Former Victoria Police deputy commissioner Wendy Steendam assures parents the childcare system is safe, vowing to safeguard children following multiple cases of alleged abuse.

items.title: Coronial inquest into Porepunkah police shootings set to begin
items.description: Two separate directions hearings will be heard in the Coroners Court of Victoria before State Coroner Judge Liberty Sanger, who will oversee the structure and scope of the inquests.

items.title: The once-promising AFL player hitting home runs in US Major League
items.description: As a teenager, Curtis Mead had to choose between an iconically Australian sport and America's pastime. He's now hitting home runs in Major League Baseball.

items.title: Tottenham saves EPL status with win as West Ham goes down
items.description: Tottenham Hotspur salvages its Premier League status in the nick of time, with Joao Palhinha's first-half goal earning a priceless 1-0 home victory over Everton.

items.title: Man dies after shark attack in Far North Queensland
items.description: A 39-year-old man has died following a shark attack in Far North Queensland.

items.title: How these people's lives have changed since quitting alcohol
items.description: Here's what you had to say about leaving alcohol behind and how it's impacted your health, friendships and lifestyle.

items.title: A movie about mystery-hunting sheep delights this May
items.description: Plus the rom-com of yore returns in Finding Emily, the farmyard mystery that's been delighting audiences, and a gory Hollywood video game adaptation filmed on the Gold Coast.

items.title: Quiz: Will you land a knockout punch on this week's history round?
items.description: Which is older — Alien or Star Wars? And which sea creature did the UK and Iceland go to war over?

items.title: Turkish police raid opposition party HQ, fire tear gas at supporters
items.description: The raid marks the end of a three-day stand-off between members of the opposition CHP party and police.

items.title: Scientist 'shocked' $300m irrigation scheme pushing ahead without studies
items.description: A $300 million irrigation scheme will supply 37.2 gigalitres of water to farming areas near Hobart from 2030. A scientists fears the taxpayer-funded scheme could put a major river at risk.

items.title: At least 24 killed in Pakistan train blast claimed by separatist militants
items.description: A bomb blast has hit a shuttle train carrying Pakistani security personnel and their families in the latest major attack claimed by separatist militants.

items.title: Truro businesses call for certainty on freight bypass project
items.description: SA businesses situated along a major thoroughfare say they are holding back on making decisions about their future, amid uncertainty surrounding a slated road project that could divert traffic around the area.

items.title: Pocock open to party of independents as One Nation support climbs
items.description: The independent senator says Australians are frustrated with a political system that "does not work for them".

items.title: Politics and faith collide over choice for Tibet's next Dalai Lama
items.description: Tibetan Buddhists believe the Dalai Lama decides when and where he will reincarnate. But China's ruling Communist Party says it must choose who will replace him.

items.title: North Queensland crowd raises record figure for Arrow and MND charity
items.description: North Queensland climbs into the NRL's top six with an impressive 30-18 victory over South Sydney in Townsville, where fans raise thousands of dollars for the Fight MND charity.

items.title: Giants create AFL history with onslaught, Dogs down Dees in classic
items.description: Greater Western Sydney has left reigning premier Brisbane reeling with a record-breaking goal surge, while the Bulldogs get home in a see-sawing contest against the Demons.
